BlogEntry.description: A My Blog entry, as documented for the API response.

pubDate.description: Publication date. The documentation gives an example such as `Sun, 24 Feb 2019 10:00:00 +0800` but does not specify a machine-readable date format.

info.description: API for searching the Financial Secretary's My Blog entries. The version value is a metadata placeholder, not a publisher API version. The publisher documentation does not specify authentication requirements.
info.title: Financial Secretary - My Blog

get.description: Searches My Blog entries. All times are in HKT (GMT+8). If both date parameters are omitted, entries from the last six months are returned. A maximum of 400 records is returned.

parameters.description: Language of the blog. The English API resource uses `en`, the Traditional Chinese resource uses `tc`, and the Simplified Chinese resource uses `sc`.
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Start date (inclusive) in YYYYMMDD format, for example `20190102`. The earliest accepted date is 16 January 2017. Must be used together with `end`.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: End date (inclusive) in YYYYMMDD format, for example `20190109`. The latest accepted date is today. Must be used together with `start`.
parameters.name: end

data.description: Blog entries. The publisher documentation does not identify the enclosing response property name; this array represents the documented entry collection without asserting that its wire key is `data`.

200.description: Successful response. The documented API fields describe each blog entry; the source does not specify the enclosing JSON response structure.
